title: cystopteris filix-fragilis
intro: Cystopteris filix-fragilis, commonly known as fragile fern or cleft lip fern, is a species of fern in the family Cystopteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cystopteris filix-fragilis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm irritated skin, reduce inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antiseptic, and antiviral properties.
